findings.description: Parameters without '=' are now stored with value True. In get_encoding_from_headers, `params["charset"].strip(...)` is called on that value, which is a bool.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a header such as `text/html; charset` (a bare charset token with no '='). The parser stores params_dict['charset']=True, so `"charset" in params` is true and `True.strip` raises AttributeError. Impact: response.encoding / response.text crashes on a malformed but plausible header instead of falling back to the default encoding.
